title: The Christmas trees come a week later
setting: The logistics coordinator of a regional garden-centre chain (three sites)

events.from: Ruth Okoro (finance manager, Fernhill Garden Centres)
events.text: Any supplier order over $1,500 needs my sign-off before it's placed, and again before any change to it goes back to the supplier.

events.from: Delia Park (head of sales, Fernhill Garden Centres)
events.text: Once we've agreed a delivery date with a business customer, it must not be moved without the customer's agreement. If something forces a change, ask them first and wait for their yes.
Bookings with our own drivers, the forklift hire and the display teams are the logistics office's to move without checking with me, as long as the person is told the new details in writing.
Could we have the Christmas tree yard at Westfield in the side car park again? It worked well last year.

Quote for this Christmas: 400 Nordmann firs, 5 to 6 ft, netted, at $17 each, $6,800 in total, delivered to one site of your choice in late November. We'll give you the exact delivery day once our cutting plan is set.
With Ruth's sign-off, ordered 400 Nordmann firs from Hollin Farm Trees at $17 each, $6,800, all to be delivered to our Calder Bridge yard.
We'd like 30 netted Nordmann firs in stands for our office buildings again this year, delivered by your team in the last week of November if possible.
A forklift with a driver is $260 for a morning. We just need the date and start time at least a week ahead.

events.from: Delia Park (head of sales, Fernhill Garden Centres)
events.text: Let's brief all three site managers together on Monday 16 November at 08:30 in the Calder Bridge staff room.
Booked the Calder Bridge staff room for the Christmas briefing with the three site managers, Monday 16 November at 08:30.
Delivery booking: your 400 Nordmann firs will come to the Calder Bridge yard on our lorry on Tuesday 24 November, arriving at 07:00. Please have a forklift ready to unload.
Booked Liftwise Plant Hire's forklift and driver for the Calder Bridge yard on Tuesday 24 November from 07:00, to unload the Hollin Farm firs, $260.
Happy to do the tree run to Westfield and Ashby Road in the big lorry. I'd load at Calder Bridge from 07:30 and leave at 08:00, and I'd be done by early afternoon.

Wes Hollis will take the firs on to the other two sites the morning after they're unloaded at Calder Bridge: Wednesday 25 November, leaving Calder Bridge at 08:00 with 150 for Westfield and 130 for Ashby Road.
We can build your tree yards at Westfield and Ashby Road on the afternoon the trees arrive there, starting at 13:00. $480 for both sites.
Booked Duarte Displays to build the Christmas tree yards at Westfield and Ashby Road on the afternoon Wes drops the trees off, Wednesday 25 November from 13:00, $480.
400 cast-iron tree stands at $3.50 each, $1,400, delivered to Calder Bridge on Friday 20 November.

Ordered 400 tree stands from Brackley Supplies, one for each Hollin Farm fir, delivered to the Calder Bridge yard on Friday 20 November so they're in before the firs arrive on Tuesday 24 November. $1,400.
Agreed with Joan Pryce: 30 netted Nordmann firs in stands for Larchmont Business Park, delivered from Calder Bridge on Thursday 26 November, two days after our firs come in. $1,050.
Separately from the firs, your 120 holly wreaths will come straight to Westfield on Thursday 26 November in our small van.
We'll keep the side car park at Westfield clear for the tree yard from mid-November.
5 rolls of tree netting for your netting machines, $210, delivered to Calder Bridge on Thursday 12 November.
Ordered 5 rolls of tree netting from Brackley Supplies for the three sites' netting machines, delivered to Calder Bridge on Thursday 12 November, $210.
Delivery note for your records: 400 Nordmann firs to the Calder Bridge yard, Tuesday 24 November, arriving 07:00. Our driver will be Ray.
Bev rang to say the forklift driver for our Calder Bridge unload will be Lee.
To do: pay Liftwise's $60 deposit for the forklift by Friday 13 November. Not paid yet.

The wet October has put our cutting about a week behind, so I've had to rebook your delivery: the 400 Nordmann firs will now arrive at the Calder Bridge yard on Tuesday 1 December at 07:00, not Tuesday 24 November. Same lorry, same price, same quantity.
The big lorry is booked in for its service on Monday 9 November, so it'll be off the road that day only.
Westfield and Ashby Road both have their tree-yard fencing up.

records.title: Tree run to Westfield and Ashby Road
Tree yard build at Westfield and Ashby Road
Christmas briefing for the site managers

task: Please send Wes the details for the Christmas tree run to Westfield and Ashby Road: the date and the time he leaves Calder Bridge.
why: Hollin Farm rebooked the fir delivery from Tuesday 24 November to Tuesday 1 December (the change replaces the delivery booking). The forklift follows the delivery, Wes's run is the morning after the unload and the display build is the afternoon Wes drops the trees off; all are driver, forklift or display bookings the office may move (Callum's rule), so they are REVISE to 1, 2 and 2 December, and Wes is told 2 December, leaving at 08:00. The Larchmont delivery is a date agreed with a business customer, so moving it needs Joan Pryce's agreement (ASK); the stands arriving on 20 November are still in before the firs (KEEP); the fir order, the netting and the briefing do not rest on the delivery date.
